items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) that could lead to unauthenticated customer account takeover and privilege escalation. Successful exploitation could also result in security feature bypass and arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes, a Magento extension, allowing attackers to write executable files to a store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.3 and was fixed in version 4.0.0.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PHP object injection)
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, which could lead to remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie. The flaw is rated 9.8 (critical) and Mirasvit released a patched version (1.11.12) on May 25, 2026.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, bypassing validation. This can lead to remote code execution or account takeover, and attacks have been observed on a significant percentage of stores.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a critical security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source to protect against multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, or gain unauthorized access to store data.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This Adobe security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.
